Normalize sample abundances

step_normalize.Rd

Use glyclean::auto_normalize() or select a normalize_* function by its suffix. The step updates the active experiment (exp). The first cleaning step saves its input in raw_exp.

Usage

step_normalize(
  method = c("auto", "median", "median_abs", "median_quotient", "total_area", "quantile",
    "loessf", "loesscyc", "rlr", "rlrma", "rlrmacyc", "vsn"),
  ...
)

Arguments

method

Use "auto" to choose by experiment type, or select "median", "median_abs", "median_quotient", "total_area", "quantile", "loessf", "loesscyc", "rlr", "rlrma", "rlrmacyc" or "vsn".

...

Arguments for the selected glyclean function. For example, glyclean::normalize_median_quotient() accepts by to normalize within groups, and glyclean::normalize_rlrmacyc() accepts n_iter.

Value

A glysmith_step object.

Examples

blueprint(step_normalize("median_quotient", by = "group"), step_pca())
#> 
#> ── Blueprint (2 steps) ──
#> 
#> • step_normalize("median_quotient", by = "group")
#> • step_pca()
